observation.visible_scene: A static tabletop still-life: a white round plate piled with pale, pleated boiled dumplings (khinkali-style) sits centered on a tan/beige woven tablecloth. In the soft-focus background are the stems/bases of two wine glasses (top-left and top-right), a second white plate with a metal fork at the right edge, and small pieces of green garnish peeking in at the bottom edge. The composition, object positions and lighting direction remain the same throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: A gradual, continuous increase in overall image brightness/exposure from the dark first frame to the noticeably lighter final frame (the tablecloth and dumpling surfaces brighten progressively across frames 1→41).
No movement of the dumplings, plate, glasses, fork or garnish is detectable; relative positions of all objects to each other and to the frame edges stay constant.
The brightening is smooth and monotonic across the sampled frames, not a sudden cut or flicker.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the exposure ramp began before t=0 and whether it continues past t=1.333s.
The cause of the brightness change (camera/exposure adjustment vs. an actual change in scene lighting) is not determinable from the frames alone.
uncertain_details: Any extremely slight camera drift or zoom is unverifiable because the background elements shift by at most a few pixels and could be measurement noise; the scene is best treated as camera-static.
The exact timing/curve of the brightening (linear vs. eased) cannot be pinned down from the sparse samples.
